test.oracleId: WP505 immutable authored-computed register and bounded Query-IR model assertions

modelAssertions: Authored entries are caller-authored inputs and can never claim computed origin or reserved computed identity.
Computed entries are derived one-for-one from the complete exact WP504 dossier denominator.
Authored and computed records remain visibly and structurally distinct in every projection and result.
Authored evidence references must exist in the exact WP504 evidence universe.
Every projection binds project revision snapshot generation shared row set and predecessor projection digests.
Query IR admits only seven typed fields three typed operators three order fields and a bounded result limit.
Ask Atlas performs deterministic local filtering and returns exact register records rather than synthesized truth.
Projection and result digests are independently recomputable and tamper-evident.
The feature manifest grants no mutation persistence renderer wiring network external AI or platform effect authority.
The node is bounded to WP505 and makes no graph advance or PROGRAM_DONE claim.
